hero.name: Alessio Brunello
hero.tagline: I build scalable frontend systems and lead delivery teams, integrating Cursor, Claude Code, Grok, and agentic workflows into everyday engineering.

about.title: About Me
about.description: I'm a Frontend Tech Lead with over 10 years of experience building modern, performant, and scalable web and mobile applications. I focus on designing intuitive digital solutions, leading development teams, and contributing to architectural decisions to ensure high-quality products.
about.description2: I work daily with React, TypeScript, and modern web technologies. I treat AI as an engineering multiplier: I use Cursor, Claude Code, Grok and Grok Bots, MCP, and agentic workflows in delivery, prototyping, and code review.
about.description3: I'm deeply passionate about artificial intelligence and stay relentlessly up to date: I follow the latest releases, try them immediately, and bring them into real work—beyond the hype, with concrete impact.

teaching.title: Teaching & Sharing
teaching.subtitle: I love explaining things: turning AI novelty into skills people can actually use
teaching.intro: Beyond building products, I love transferring know-how. I design and run beginner and advanced courses on using artificial intelligence—both for everyday life and for software development.

tracks.title: AI for everyday life
tracks.description: How to use AI assistants practically to write better, organize work, research faster, and reclaim time without feeling overwhelmed by the tech.

tracks.title: AI for development
tracks.description: Hands-on workflows with Cursor, Claude Code, Grok, and Grok Bots: agentic coding, effective prompting, MCP, and bringing AI into the delivery cycle.

beyond.title: Beyond code
beyond.subtitle: Things that light me up when I'm not building software
beyond.intro: Work is an important part of my life, but not the only one. Outside of code there are curiosities, habits, and people who keep me grounded — and looking ahead.

items.title: Technology & gadgets
items.description: I'm passionate about technology in general: I like understanding how things work, trying new gadgets, and bringing them into everyday life in a useful way — not just collecting them.

items.title: Apple ecosystem
items.description: I love the Apple platform and use it end to end every day: iPhone, Mac, Apple Watch, Apple TV, and iPad — at home, for photos, and for work.

items.title: Electric mobility
items.description: I've been driving a Tesla Model 3 for four years and I support electric mobility. No preaching: when people ask, I simply share my experiences — without hate and without pressure.

items.title: Finance
items.description: I study finance in my spare time out of passion and personal interest: a way to understand the world better, not a second job.

items.title: Sports
items.description: I enjoy fishing and play airsoft on a team: two different ways to be outdoors, stay focused, and have fun with others.

items.title: Family
items.description: I have a wonderful family: I live with an extraordinary wife and a little daughter who is already much smarter than I am.
